# United WatchMart

> United WatchMart makes automatic watches in steel, gold and ceramic, assembled by hand. The site explains how each watch is built, lists every reference with its price in US dollars, and takes requests for private viewings. Available in English (/en) and Arabic (/ar).

## Pages

- [Home](https://unitedwatchmart.com/en): The Heritage 42, taken apart layer by layer.
- [Collection](https://unitedwatchmart.com/en/collection): All nine watches, filterable by strap.
- [Anatomy of a watch](https://unitedwatchmart.com/en/anatomy): Six chapters on the crystal, bezel, dial and hands, movement, case and bracelet.
- [Pricing](https://unitedwatchmart.com/en/pricing): Every reference with its price.
- [About](https://unitedwatchmart.com/en/about): How and why the watches are made.
- [Privacy and terms](https://unitedwatchmart.com/en/legal)

## Watches

- [Heritage 42](https://unitedwatchmart.com/en/watch/heritage-42): UW 1042.SG, 42 mm steel, 18k gold bezel, automatic, 72 h, $4,900
- [Octane GT](https://unitedwatchmart.com/en/watch/octane-gt): UW 2043.RB, 43 mm steel, automatic chronograph, rubber, $6,200
- [Midnight Chrono](https://unitedwatchmart.com/en/watch/midnight-chrono): UW 3044.RG, 44 mm rose gold, automatic chronograph, leather, $7,400
- [Aurelian](https://unitedwatchmart.com/en/watch/aurelian): UW 4043.YG, 43 mm steel, semi-skeleton, $8,900
- [Verdant](https://unitedwatchmart.com/en/watch/verdant): UW 5044.GR, 44 mm rose gold, green ceramic, $9,800
- [Tachy Skeleton](https://unitedwatchmart.com/en/watch/tachy-skeleton): UW 6044.SK, 44 mm steel, skeleton chronograph, $12,600
- [Onyx Skeleton](https://unitedwatchmart.com/en/watch/onyx-skeleton): UW 7043.CE, 43 mm black ceramic, flying tourbillon, $18,900
- [Maestro Tourbillon](https://unitedwatchmart.com/en/watch/maestro-tourbillon): UW 8044.TB, 44 mm rose gold, flying tourbillon, $24,500
- [Blue Tourbillon](https://unitedwatchmart.com/en/watch/blue-tourbillon): UW 9044.BT, 44 mm rose gold, open-worked, flying tourbillon, $28,900
